header.title: Calibration report
header.shiftNote: Shifts are worked out from production time and can differ from the vendor screen's Shift column.
reportNotes: Drift is judged on daily station means against the line; a station is flagged when a pattern test fired inside a run of consecutive days on one side of the line, of at least the minimum length, at least the threshold away. Adjustments are those logged in this system from go-live; nothing before it is recorded. Weighing data cannot tell a heavy scale from heavy cones, so no direction of adjustment is stated. An adjustment logged for the whole line (no station) is listed as such and is not counted in any single station figure.

header.title: Shift-wise CTS Loop Production Report
header.shiftNote: Shifts are worked out from production time and can differ from the vendor screen's Shift column.
reportNotes: Each cone is counted once. Weighed is every cone the scale weighed; weight rejects are the cones the scale rejected on weight (the weight-reject records); pass is the cones weighed that carry no weight-reject record; total is pass plus weight rejects, so a cone that was weighed and then rejected on weight counts once, as a reject. Efficiency is pass divided by total. Quality (inspection) rejects are not part of this efficiency, as in IFL’s own shift report. Winder is the weighing station.
CTS loop: the line’s one hanger loop — 282 hanger numbers seen in this period.
The scale’s own in-range bit marked 0 cones; the weight-reject records hold 0; they are separate records and are not merged.
Weighed kg is the sum of the plausible cone weights, as the scale recorded them. 0 readings outside the plausibility window are not in it.
No product change was read on any winder in this period.
